'''0.25c''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that restored [[Radar]] to the map rotation and fixed various bugs.

==Changelog==
* Fixed crash on loading location "[[Vostok Radar Station]]", the map is back in rotation
* Fixed display premium items in the starter bundles
* Removed the command line "one_texture"
* Fixed a bug which caused the waste of all existing player boosters (radio, drinks ... ) in one fight, all funds spent have been compensated
* Fixed item modification bug that led to unexpected modifications. All the "extra" modifiers removed, funds spent have been compensated
* Fixed the crouch animation, removed strong swinging when moving left/right
